works.body:
Hey! I‘m a German singer and rapper and I‘m looking for a cover artwork for my new song. It is a fairy-tale themed song that deals with the story of „Snow White“ and a lot of winter and ice themes. So for the artwork I imagine myself as the prince (curly blonde male, dressed nicely, elegant) in some kind of interaction (maybe classical dancing or holding/kissing her hand, etc.) with a second character that is the princess „Snow White“ (long black hair, white skin,  blood red lips, white dress, etc.). I would like it to be in light, blue-ish and icy colors that fit the cold winter theme. I really like the watercolor/pastel art style from your instagram pictures from 25.11 and 02.12. 
i will put the link to a picture from my instagram to the URL so you can see how I look like (for the prince).
Thank you <3
